messages:
Hannah (Marketing): hey team :wave: — need an "omnichannel benchpack" for the upcoming launch. Deliverables: benchmark hero diagram (print + web), 2 webinar slides (intro + data slide), 1-pager PDF, 4 social tiles (1200x1200 + vertical story), email header, and an SVG inbound-routing map that we can drop into HubSpot. Target: go-live by Tue EOD (2026-04-07). Can you confirm capacity and list any blockers?

Jules (Design): can take this. quick q: which benchmark numbers should we surface (latency p50/p95, tokens/sec, unit cost)? and do we have final copy for the tiles + 1-pager? also need approved customer logos if we call them out.

Hannah (Marketing): priority is latency p50/p95 and cost per 1k tokens. copy for hero + slides: short headlines only, i'll paste below. logos: only use partners from the whitelist (see legal). i'll @Sam for the raw numbers and a figma link.

Sam (Product): posting data now — Drive: https://drive.google.com/drive/fake-bench-data (folder has CSV + spreadsheet). key numbers: p50=42ms, p95=120ms, gen cost=$0.007/1k tokens. also added model variants table.

Nina (Marketing Ops): for the inbound-routing SVG — we map form -> segment -> SFDC lead record -> campaign source. confirm SFDC field mapping or i can provide a CSV. example mapping snippet:```FormField,SegmentName,SFDC_Field
email,Inbound - Webinar,Email
company,Inbound - Webinar,Company
benchmark_interest,Benchpack,Product_Interest__c```

Liam (Growth): copy suggestions for social (short):
- "Serving wins: lower latency, lower cost"
- "Benchmarked: 42ms p50, 120ms p95"
Keep CTAs simple: "Join the webinar" / "See the benchpack"

Jules (Design): thanks — that'll do. timeline: hero diagram + webinar slides first (Mon WIP), then 1-pager + social tiles (Tue). file specs: hero web PNG 1400x800, hero print PDF 8.5x11, social 1200x1200 + 1080x1920 for story, email header 600x200, SVG for routing. will output named files like: `bench-hero-web.png`, `bench-webinar-1.pdf`, `bench-social-1.png` etc.

Hannah (Marketing): perfect. also need localization variants: en + fr + de. can we get those regenerated from the source copy?

Jules (Design): we can layout EN and leave editable text layers for localization handoff. translation copy please as separate file — tag with locale suffix (`_fr`, `_de`).

Legal (Legal): quick flag — do NOT use any customer logos without explicit written approval. partner logos from the approved whitelist are ok. also avoid making performance claims that imply SLAs. use phrasing like "benchmarked" or "measured in our testbeds."

Sam (Product): noted — added a short README in Drive with wording: "Measured under internal testbed conditions; not an SLA."

Nina (Marketing Ops): regarding HubSpot, i need the SVG with labeled nodes so I can map IDs to form fields. Jules — please export a version with element IDs.

Jules (Design): yep — i'll include `id` attributes on export. also will post a WIP figma link by Mon morning: https://www.figma.com/file/ABC123/omnichannel-benchpack (comment-only link).

Hannah (Marketing): priority order: 1) hero diagram + webinar slides 2) inbound-routing SVG 3) 1-pager PDF 4) social tiles + email header. keep me posted on blockers. :thumbsup:

Jules (Design): will deliver WIP Mon 09:00 PT, final by Tue 14:00 PT. ping me here if copy changes.

Liam (Growth): I'll draft short alt copy for social and a 2-line webinar blurb and drop in the Drive by tonight.

Hannah (Marketing): lovely — thanks everyone. closing loop: once WIP is up i'll run a quick brand-compliance sweep and loop Legal if needed.

Jules (Design): good plan. I'll upload exports to the shared Drive folder and tag `@Hannah` when ready.
